svg.aria-label: An 8 wide group through map and rename
svg.text: An 8 wide group through map and rename
One cycle. Map resolves dependences inside the group, rename hands out physical registers, the history file remembers what to undo.
The group as decode delivers it
Measured limits and a proposed cause
Map: an 8 × 8 compare of destinations against sources, row reads column
Eliminate: mov x4,x3 points at the register slot 2 will write; mov x5,#7 goes to the
Fuse: cmp + b.ne become one branch uop with a flag write
Rename: the free list hands out physical registers; the history file keeps the old
reads 4 registers per 6 instructions at most
one integer map entry (32 of them)
sec: set when this process wrote the register; reading an unwritten
one slows integer issue to about 4 wide
v: zero idiom, reads as zero with no physical register
one history file entry, per uop that changes the map
16 retired per clock, old register freed
nop, b, stores and compares take no entry, so the NOP window (2277) and the register writing
Mispredict: walk from the tail back to the branch, old physical into the map, new physical to the
free list; 16 per clock, worst case 39 clocks
4 integer banks, bank power gating, 2 to 3 clocks to wake (patent)
Test: fused pairs with fewer live sources should fuse past 4 per 6 if
the port budget is the cause
